why: Company IR release: FY2026 Q4 and year-end (FYE 2026-07-31) results after market close Monday 2026-09-28, call 5:00 p.m. ET. Calendar row is correct.
session_evidence: Release 'after market close on Monday, September 28, 2026', conference call 5:00 p.m. ET: https://investors.vailresorts.com/news-releases/news-release-details/vail-resorts-announces-fiscal-2026-fourth-quarter-and-year-end
where_to_look: The September print carries the season-pass sales update and the first FY2027 guide, and those move it, not the reported Q4. Epic Pass unit data before the price deadlines: resort and pass-reseller pages, ski-industry trade press (e.g. NSAA, SKI), social chatter about the Labor Day deadline, compared with the June update (units -10%, dollars -5% through 2026-05-26).

Activist trail: Oasis Management's fifth 13D/A, filed 2026-09-22, took its stake to 7.4% from 6.2%. Read the 13D exhibits and letters on EDGAR for demands (cost cuts, capital return, board seats) that could land in the release.
Early-season snow and Australian season (Perisher, Falls Creek, Hotham) visitation, which fall inside the fiscal Q4 just reported, plus any Whistler/Canada visitation data.
Capital-return signals: dividend level versus FCF after the guide cuts. A dividend change would be a separate line from the guide.
already_in_the_wire: FY2026 guide was cut in April and reaffirmed at the lower level in June: net income $128-162m, Resort Reported EBITDA $735-755m (https://investors.vailresorts.com/news-releases/news-release-details/vail-resorts-reports-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results-provides)
Early pass sales through 2026-05-26: units -10%, days -8%, dollars -5%
Oasis 13D/A to 7.4% on 2026-09-22; short interest 16.3% of float (ORTEX, 2026-09-25)
trades_on: Pass-sales update and the guide. The Dec-2025 +9.32% print reaffirmed guidance and showed pass dollars +3% (https://investors.vailresorts.com/news-releases/news-release-details/vail-resorts-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-and-season-pass). The Jun-2026 -4.34% print carried the -10% unit pass update (https://investors.vailresorts.com/news-releases/news-release-details/vail-resorts-reports-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results-provides). The reported quarter is seasonal noise.
short_interest: 16.3% of free float, ORTEX, data 2026-09-25 (https://ortex.news/articles/172330/analysts-cut-targets-as-oasis-raises-stake-before-mtn-print). Days to cover not stated. Other snippets gave 19-20% on other dates; unverified.
